overview: Arjun is a unique brawler/zoner with a flip on the traditional grappler style. Rather than making the opponent constantly guess in close quarters, Arjun hammers his opponents with multiple plus on block specials that stack grey life on block, making the opponent's attempt to fight back twice as risky. One wrong decision sacrifices all that accrued grey life, intimidating opponents into passive play. When on defense, Arjun's opponent will be constantly deciding whether aggression is worth the risk of a grey life cash-in.

Arjun has a variety of decent normals; 5HP boasts gigantic range and a target combo followup that allows strike/throw mix mid-screen or a SA3 cancel in the corner. If his opponent tries to retreat, Arjun can throw out 2MP, a safe on block (if well spaced) sweep similar to Dee Jay's 2MK. Once you've gotten in, 5LP is a plus on block jab that leaves Arjun in throw range, starting his offensive pressure. 2HK is a unique if slow sweep that can be special cancelled to remain safe if blocked. Lastly, 5HK can be used as a long range anti-air with a target combo followup.

Arm of Justice is a central column of Arjun's offense. It can be canceled into or sent freely in neutral as it is always safe, can be spaced to be plus on block, and does a decent amount of gray life on block. If they take to the skies, Cruel Shoulder is a powerful body projectile that anti airs and knocks down the opponent right next to Arjun on hit, setting up one of his most important special moves -- Divine Pillar. Arjun blows into the ground and creates a rock spire that hits low and stays on the screen on a timer. He can change its eruption timing and placement, setting up strike-throw oki situations at most ranges, especially in the corner.

When using Shoulder and passing through a placed Pillar, Arjun grabs the Pillar and turns it into Justice Beyond, a column that swings in a 360 degree arc with immense range. This follow up deals staggering amounts of grey life and Drive Gauge damage, pushes the opponent to full screen, catches jumping opponents even if they are behind Arjun, and claims a ton of ground. It comes out insanely fast, blows through Drive Impact, is safe on block, and can even catch late Pillar launches. The only true option for your opponent to respond with is to Parry, giving Arjun opportunities to feint a light Shoulder and get a sneaky PC throw, starting his pressure loop all over again. And best of all, landing it as a clean hit gives him a ground bounce follow up, allowing him to link into other specials and do staggering damage from one surprise special. All of these offensive options when combined with built grey life make Arjun terrifying to defend against for long.

When your opponent starts to Parry to protect their life bar, throw in a Ghastly Interrogation, a command grab that either applies grey life, or cashes out grey life Arjun has already applied, scaring the opponent into jumping or backdashing. Opponents trying to zone Arjun out will be forced to deal with Indomitable Defense, a unique counter that only activates on strikes and stays active against projectiles (making him effectively invincible to even multi-hit fireballs and supers like Shinku Hadoken). Punish them from this with Moral Breakdown, a special followup that deals immense damage on hit or gray damage on block, and can be linked into after landing Shoulder with Pillar for huge punishes. If you hold the advantage from afar, utilize the Breathing Ring, a projectile similar to Ed's one-two fireball, but can be angled to catch jumps and hold your opponent in place.

Arjun might be a battering ram of a character, but he suffers from numerous weaknesses, such as no reliable reversals, many subpar normals, limited cancelable buttons, and slow walk and Drive Rush speeds. Many of Arjun's normals are either slow or situational, and he lacks a cancelable 2MK/2MP to start offensive pressure. Enhanced Shoulder is a phenomenal offensive tool, but placing a Pillar is punishable without proper oki, and when placed, the opponent can body block it to make Shoulder a riskier play. Indomitable Defense is a good option, but is too slow to be a reversal and suffers from throws, limiting his wakeup options. While he has good health, his walk speed makes neutral tricky and chasing a careful opponent difficult. If Arjun has not pressured his opponent with specials, his command throw cannot deal normal damage, only a serviceable amount of grey life, minimizing its use as a punish tool.

Arjun is not to be underestimated. Though he has some weaknesses, he is an incredibly unorthodox and intimidating character to fight, and his potential lies in tricking his rival into eating his brutal offensive pressure, preparing for the big cashout. Leave your opponent breathless with the path of Yoga.

pick.text: Absolute Unit: Has some of the highest damage in the game with gray life & regular routes dealing immense damage.
Intimidation Interrogation: Constant looping plus frames & the threat of building too much gray life gives Arjun great pressure once he gets in & potential to win games off of a stray connection.
S.W.A.T: Anti Airs that lead into damaging combos & corner carry.
On The Run: Decent zoning ability with 2 unique projectiles with different properties.

Enduring Defense: Thanks to having a frame 3 counter, Arjun can get through a lot of Burnout pressure that other characters struggle with, including most Drive Impact setups while having options to deal with block checks

avoid.text: Long, Slow, Investigation: Slow walk speed makes closing in on an opponent or escaping their buttons difficult
Cancelability Woes: Aside from his lights & 5MP, Arjun doesn't have many traditional cancelable pokes like most of the cast
Represented By Himself: A lack of OD reversals makes him rely on system mechanics and reads to escape a bad situation.
Below The Law: Needs to set a pillar in order to access his more damaging combo routes forcing him to either apply pressure or use the knockdown to set a pillar
Unorthodox: With most of his buttons being unorthodox & untraditional compared to the average character's set, Arjun is always playing a different neutral game to his opponent in any match up

moves.name: Instant Oblivion
moves.notes: Short horizontal range (impractical as a projectile counter); has a decent anti-air hitbox on active frames 1-2 but can whiff under close jumps; deals 200 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout)

moves.name: Divine Pillar
moves.notes: Button strength determines pillar distance (LK close, MK middle, HK far); holding the button results in a delayed activation with a screen shake effect; second pillar puts the opponent into a limited juggle OTG state (can follow up with Justice Beyond); can be auto-spaced for safety on block against most characters by canceling from 2HP (also creates a frame trap)

moves.name: OD Divine Pillar
moves.notes: Button combination determines pillar distance (LK+MK close, LK+HK middle, MK+HK far); holding the buttons results in a delayed activation with a screen shake effect; second pillar puts the opponent into a limited juggle OTG state (can follow up with Justice Beyond); can be auto-spaced for safety on block against most characters by canceling from 2HP (also creates a frame trap)

moves.name: Justice Beyond
moves.notes: Occurs automatically when Cruel Shoulder connects with a placed Divine Pillar (startup is counted from the frame Arjun reaches the pillar); will auto-correct if Arjun is behind the opponent when swinging the pillar; no difference between strengths of Cruel Shoulder or Divine Pillar (including OD versions); Arjun can connect with both Cruel Shoulder and Justice Beyond if the opponent is close enough to the Pillar (results in a higher KD advantage); deals 1000 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); Arjun builds significant Drive Gauge on hit or block compared to most special moves (0.8 bars)

moves.name: Indomitable Defense
moves.notes: Absorbs any strike or projectile attack (including Super Arts) without incurring any recoverable damage; automatically performs a counter-attack when absorbing a strike; absorbing a projectile incurs the usual 30f recovery animation after releasing the button; this counter-attack is a guaranteed punish and cannot be baited with a fast normal; counter-attack deals only recoverable damage and cannot KO the opponent; can walk forward or backward while holding button (walk speed: 0.02 in either direction); counter-attack will autocorrect to face the opponent if they switch sides; Arjun is in a counter-hit state on frames 1-2 and a Punish Counter state for the rest of the move duration (including the Moral Breakdown follow-up); depletes 0.3 Drive bars on hit; useful reversal in some blockstrings (such as Drive Impact blockstrings in Burnout if the gap is 3f or larger)

moves.name: Moral Breakdown
moves.notes: 11-hit OD-priority projectile hitbox (disappears if Arjun is hit); can be used to safely pressure without the threat of Drive Impact or reversal SA1; puts opponent into a limited juggle state (slightly higher launch vs. airborne opponents); extremely high juggle potential (can be used for a meterless ender after Justice Beyond); Arjun is in a Punish Counter state for the entire move duration; deals 1100 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the large number of hits allows it to clash with Super projectiles long enough for Arjun to recover and punish the opponent (despite not depleting any of the Super's hits); Arjun extends a forward hurtbox on frames 28-66 that is vulnerable only to aerial strikes; Arjun will autocorrect to face the opponent if they switch sides during his counter stance

moves.name: Howling Destruction
moves.notes: 12-hit Super-priority projectile hitbox; aims near the ground before sweeping outward and upward (less range on early active frames but reaches fullscreen on the final 2 hits); can hit cross-up (even on grounded opponents if they extend a forward hurtbox while behind Arjun); useful juggle ender; can be used as an anti-fireball tool at mid range (less like to punish if clashing with multiple projectile hits); deals 100 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); Active Frame distribution: 5x11,7 (hitbox expands every 5 frames); expanded head hurtbox on frames 13-85 is projectile invincible (makes Arjun more susceptible to long range jump-in punishes)

moves.name: Yaksha's Order
moves.notes: Can be used to counter projectiles from over half screen if the opponent has an extended hurtbox; deals 300 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); cinematic time regenerates ~2.1 Drive bars for Arjun

moves.name: Yaksha's Order (CA)
moves.notes: Can be used to counter projectiles from over half screen if the opponent has an extended hurtbox; deals 300 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); available at 25% HP or below; cinematic time regenerates ~2.3 Drive bars for Arjun

moves.name: HP Arm of Justice
moves.notes: 3f extra recovery on whiff; hitstop increased by 7f on Counter-hit / 12f on Punish Counter (increases the hitconfirm window into ~6P or SA3 by the same amount)

moves.name: Breathing Ring
moves.notes: No difference between button strengths; projectile dissipates on contact with opponent; the final cancel frame into SA3 does not combo

moves.name: OD Breathing Ring
moves.notes: 2 hits; projectile moves forward slightly while active; can input follow-up even after projectile connects with opponent

moves.name: OD Breathing Shockwave
moves.notes: Button strength determines the projectile angle (LP straight, MP 45 degree angle, HP nearly vertical); shockwave has an initial hitbox in front of Arjun for 10 frames followed by a launched projectile; if the initial Breathing Ring was dissipated on hit/block or by colliding with another projectile, only this short range shockwave will come out (less useful in ranged fireball wars)

moves.name: Breathing Shockwave
moves.notes: Button strength determines the projectile angle (LP straight, MP 45 degree angle, HP nearly vertical); shockwave has an initial hitbox in front of Arjun for 10 frames followed by a launched projectile; if the initial Breathing Ring was dissipated on hit/block or by colliding with another projectile, only this short range shockwave will come out (less useful in ranged fireball wars); meter data refers to close shockwave / ranged projectile (HP projectile deals more Drive damage on Punish Counter)

moves.name: LP Arm of Justice
moves.notes: ; hitstop increased by 7f on Counter-hit / Punish Counter (increases the hitconfirm window into ~6P or SA3 by the same amount)

moves.name: MP Arm of Justice
moves.notes: ; hitstop increased by 7f on Counter-hit / Punish Counter (increases the hitconfirm window into ~6P or SA3 by the same amount)

moves.name: OD Arm of Justice
moves.notes: 3f extra recovery on whiff; hitstop increased by 7f on Counter-hit / Punish Counter (increases the hitconfirm window into ~6P or SA3 by the same amount)

moves.name: OD Arm follow-up
moves.notes: ; hitconfirm window for full sequence is increased by 7f on Counter-hit/Punish Counter 236PP due to extra hitstop

moves.name: Arm follow-up
moves.notes: ; hitconfirm window for full sequence is increased by 7f on Counter-hit 236P and by 12f on Punish Counter 236HP due to extra hitstop

moves.name: Crush Dissent
moves.notes: Fully cancelable sweep with good range; cancel does not allow a combo follow-up on grounded hit or counter-hit (requires Punish Counter or airborne juggle); Punish Counter puts the opponent into a limited juggle OTG bounce state with extra hitstop for an easy hitconfirm; useful juggle tool that keeps the opponent airborne but only has slight juggle potential itself; forward movement leaves Arjun very close to the opponent on block if not canceled; cancel into 236LP creates a safe frame trap on block; Arjun lifts up his front leg hurtbox on frames 6-14, making it strong vs. low pokes; extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles; extends a projectile invincible head hurtbox upwards on frames 2-17 (but still in a crouching state)

moves.name: Crouching Heavy Punch
moves.notes: Forces stand; Arjun's primary anti-air and a core combo tool; upper body is anti-air invuln on frames 10-16; very strong anti-air; the narrow central hitbox can hit cross-up on active frames 5-7 (most effective against air moves that extend a backward hurtbox); only cancelable on active frames 1-4 (can get strong meaty options on a deep anti-air like 236HP, 623HP, or 214K); high blockstun gives strong cancel options (can frame trap with 236HP or 623HP vs. Burnout); Arjun is in a standing state on frames 12-37 (returns to crouching on the final recovery frame); the upper body air invuln allows Arjun to low-profile certain reversals that are airborne on the first active frame (e.g. Blanka and Dee Jay [2]8KK)

moves.name: Crouching Light Kick
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; very solid range for a chainable low starter

moves.name: Crouching Light Punch
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; great range for a 5f light normal (comparable to shoto 5LK while still being chainable); topmost hurtbox on frames 1-7 is vulnerable only to aerial strikes (preventing its use as an anti-air)

moves.name: Crouching Medium Kick
moves.notes: Great range for a safe low poke; useful out of Drive Rush for a link into 5MK (closer ranges), 2MP (farther), or SA2 (max range); pushback is too far for a true strike/throw mixup on block

moves.name: Crouching Medium Punch
moves.notes: Sweep that can be spaced safely and leaves Arjun neutral on block vs. Burnout for great low pressure

moves.name: Scale of the Judged
moves.notes: Side switch; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: Back Taunt
moves.notes: "Hmmm. This will not end well for you."; tosses a rock into the air, creating a large projectile hitbox when his breath collides with it; hitbox whiffs on crouching opponents unless they extend a vertical hurtbox; deals 200 recoverable damage on block

moves.name: Standing Heavy Kick
moves.notes: Head and kicking leg hurtboxes are anti-air invuln on frames 11-17; solid anti-air but has slow startup and cannot hit cross-up; whiffs on crouching opponents unless they extend a vertical hurtbox; puts opponent into a limited juggle state (grounded hit only juggles into SA1); Punish Counter launched opponents high into the air (allows stronger follow-up juggles like a fully charged 5HK~HP Target Combo); extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles

moves.name: Penitent Fist
moves.notes: Can hold the button 30 frames for an enhanced version (releasing the button early gives the regular version with delayed timing); spike knockdown on hit; cancel does not lead to combos except a max-height juggle after anti-air 5HK into SA1; 6f blockstring gap (becomes a frame trap vs. Burnout but requires the opponent to stand block); can cancel vs. Burnout into 236HP or 623HP for a frame trap on hit or strong pressure on block; the first active frame can only connect mid-combo

moves.name: Penitent Fist (Hold)
moves.notes: Button must be held 30 frames (releasing early results in the uncharged version with delayed startup); a full charge allows the TC to combo after a 5HK Punish Counter launch; causes a wallsplat if opponent reaches the corner (reaches from near round-start distance); easily interruptible but can outspace many normals while charging, allowing Arjun to release the button for a whiff punish

moves.name: Standing Heavy Punch
moves.notes: 1f less recovery on block; long range and forward movement with an easy Target Combo hitconfirm; puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (ensures the TC follow-up will connect)

moves.name: Loose Cannon
moves.notes: Easily hitconfirmed into for a long range knockdown; always a true blockstring; HP/HK follow-ups can only be input on hit

moves.name: Hot Pursuit
moves.notes: Chases the opponent down for strong oki anywhere on the screen; cannot be input on block; can get a meaty throw, command throw, or 3-hit confirm from 2LK; if opponent Back Rises midscreen and gets hit with 2LK, Arjun can combo into a spaced 236LP~6P for a meterless knockdown (must link final 2LP on wide characters)

moves.name: Suppression
moves.notes: () refers to scaled damage from 5HP~HP combo starter; cannot be input on block; only combos in the corner (opponent is too far to connect midscreen)

moves.name: Standing Light Kick
moves.notes: Slow for a light, but has great range for a 6-frame normal; important Drive Rush check due to its speed/range (but the extended hurtbox before startup can get stuffed by longer range approaches); Arjun's only light normal that combos naturally into 236K~6HP (but can whiff at max range)

moves.name: Standing Light Punch
moves.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; good block advantage for a light normal; range is average but much shorter than 4f lights from other large-hurtbox characters

moves.name: Standing Medium Kick
moves.notes: 2f less recovery on block; Arjun shifts his foot hurtbox back on frames 7-9 (stronger vs. low pokes); core poke and combo tool

moves.name: Impose Order
moves.notes: 3f gap between hits on block; safe low ender that leaves Arjun close for a strike/throw mixup on hit; leaves Arjun +1 on Block vs. Burnout (can loop pressure several times); knocks down on counter-hit/Punish Counter (canceling into Super does not combo off the knockdown); puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state (no new combo routes but sets up a KD +42 safe jump)

moves.name: Standing Medium Punch
moves.notes: Great range and forward movement but relatively slow (comparable to a 5HP from most characters); high hitstun allows natural combo into Divine Pillar; great pressure starter especially against opponents in Burnout; leaves Arjun close enough for a link into 5LP~2LP if used at point blank while remaining safe (can walk back to avoid reversal throw on standard-sized characters)

moves.name: Neutral Taunt
moves.notes: "You challenge me? You stand no chance. Ahh... haha. Your move. Your lack of rhythm disturbs me."; can change which dance Arjun performs by holding a direction (forward/back/up/down) and extend the taunt indefinitely

moves.name: HP Cruel Shoulder
moves.notes: Reaches fullscreen; launches opponent upward followed by a limited juggle OTG bounce state; switches sides on a midscreen hit unless used from near fullscreen range; transitions into Justice Beyond when colliding with an active Divine Pillar; deals 800 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the active frames end immediately on block/parry or when absorbed by armor followed by a fixed 23f recovery (cannot gain extra block advantage with meaty timing); Super cancelable on active frames 1-5 (cannot cancel from longer ranges)

moves.name: LP Cruel Shoulder
moves.notes: Launches opponent slightly upward followed by a limited juggle OTG tumble state (can get follow-up near the corner if spaced out); transitions into Justice Beyond when colliding with an active Divine Pillar; deals 600 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the active frames end immediately on block/parry or when absorbed by armor followed by a fixed 23f recovery (cannot be made safer on block with meaty timing); Super cancelable on active frames 1-5 (cannot cancel from longer ranges)

moves.name: MP Cruel Shoulder
moves.notes: Launches opponent slightly upward followed by a limited juggle OTG tumble state (can get follow-up near the corner if spaced out); transitions into Justice Beyond when colliding with an active Divine Pillar; deals 700 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the active frames end immediately on block/parry or when absorbed by armor followed by a fixed 23f recovery (cannot be made safer on block with meaty timing); Super cancelable on active frames 1-5 (cannot cancel from longer ranges)

moves.name: OD Cruel Shoulder
moves.notes: Reaches fullscreen; launches opponent upward followed by a limited juggle OTG bounce state; switches sides on a midscreen hit unless used from near fullscreen range; transitions into Justice Beyond when colliding with an active Divine Pillar; deals 800 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the active frames end immediately on block/parry or when absorbed by armor followed by a fixed 23f recovery (cannot gain extra block advantage with meaty timing); Super cancelable on active frames 1-5 (cannot cancel from longer ranges)

moves.name: Ghastly Interrogation
moves.notes: Deals recoverable damage to the opponent (cannot K.O. a low-health opponent); if the opponent already accumulated any recoverable damage, it instead deals actual damage (+200 additional damage), can K.O. the opponent, and becomes HKD +13 leaving the opponent farther away; can be comboed into on grounded opponents but cannot be canceled into from normals; Punish Counter damage: 1840 rec / 2070

moves.name: OD Ghastly Interrogation
moves.notes: Deals recoverable damage to the opponent (cannot K.O. a low-health opponent); if the opponent already accumulated any recoverable damage, it instead deals actual damage (+200 additional damage), can K.O. the opponent, and becomes HKD +13 leaving the opponent farther away; takes a step forward on startup similar to 236PP; can be comboed into on grounded or airborne opponents but cannot be canceled into from normals; Punish Counter damage: 2530 rec / 2730

moves.name: Above the Law
moves.notes: Low Crush on frames 7-23; long range hopkick that knocks down on hit; can be spaced safely; puts opponent into a limited juggle state (can only combo with Divine Pillar); has extremely high juggle potential for ending combos (like after Justice Beyond)

moves.name: Blade of Duty
moves.notes: Long range overhead but knockdown prevents follow-up links like standard overheads; puts opponents into a limited juggle OTG bounce that can combo when combined with Divine Pillar (or a precisely spaced OD Breathing Ring); has extremely high juggle potential for ending combos (like after Justice Beyond)

moves.name: Shield of the Vindicator (Block)
moves.notes: Performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 5f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; see Drive Reversal.

moves.name: Shield of the Vindicator (Recovery)
moves.notes: Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); see Drive Reversal.

moves.name: Forward Taunt
moves.notes: "One moment. There. Many thanks."

moves.name: Excessive Force
moves.notes: See Drive Impact. Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

moves.name: Jumping Heavy Kick
moves.notes: Reaches farther downward than Arjun's other air normals (more likely to punish whiffed normals / projectiles / throw techs and harder to anti-air on reaction); knocks down the opponent on any hit (no follow-up combo is possible making it less rewarding than most air normals); lower body projectile invuln 10-21f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jumping Heavy Punch
moves.notes: Cross-up (can connect even from a point blank forward jump); spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents; 1st active frame can only hit forward while the final active frame can only hit cross-up (2 separate hitboxes overlap during the middle 4 active frames); extends a large downward hurtbox that makes it vulnerable to otherwise weak anti-airs (like many 5LP/2LP/2MP attacks); lower body projectile invuln 10-22f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jumping Light Kick
moves.notes: Strong downward hitbox priority; can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead if the opponent is in Burnout

moves.name: Jumping Light Punch
moves.notes: Fast air-to-air with strong horizontal hitbox priority

moves.name: Jumping Medium Kick
moves.notes: Greatest horizontal range of Arjun's air normals; lower body projectile invuln 9-26f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Jumping Medium Punch
moves.notes: Puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; lower body projectile invuln 8-22f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

moves.name: Righteous Verdict
moves.notes: ; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

moves.name: Drive Parry
moves.notes: See Drive Parry. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

moves.name: Drive Rush Cancel
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

moves.name: Parry Drive Rush
moves.notes: See Drive Rush; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 0.421 (min/throw), 1.810 (min/block), 3.589 (max/final DR frame)
